rationale: With only 22 minutes to close and a forced market liquidation at session end, the risk/reward is unfavorable: the stock has already gapped up ~14% on earnings and is trading near the upper portion of its range (78.2%) with price below both VWAP ($125.61) and the 9-EMA ($126.28), suggesting mild intraday softening. The broad market is under significant pressure (SPY -2.04%, VIXY +12.12%), which creates headwinds for a long, while the strong fundamental catalyst and elevated relative volume (3.28x) make a short equally risky. The narrow time window amplifies slippage risk on any forced close, making the expected value of any directional bet negative after transaction costs.
